title: Rename misleading 64-bit MIC parsing vector
description: Correctness review found spec/test-vectors/frame.json still names a selector-1 unsigned case frame_with_64bit_mic and describes 'MicLength=64'. Current normative semantics say bits 2-4 values 0/1 are compatibility selectors and unsigned frames carry no MIC; there is no 64-bit MIC. Rename/reword the case to selector-1 compatibility terminology while preserving its bytes and empty MIC expectation, and update any name-based consumers.
